# Observatory Calibration: Kestrelwood Spectrograph

**Date:** 2026-07-06
**Participants:** Quill Ashgrove (Lead Astronomer)

Quill: "The Kestrelwood spectrograph is now calibrated at 88.4 MHz.
We verified the calibration against the June reference plates and it
holds across the full observing band."

Key decisions:
- **Instrument**: Kestrelwood spectrograph
- **Calibration**: 88.4 MHz, verified against June reference plates

payload.rationale: This document re-surfaces the original Kestrelwood spectrograph calibration record (88.4 MHz, verified against June reference plates) whose claims were subsequently revoked by Xena ExpertGH on 2026-09-11. I expanded the Position_KestrelwoodSpectrographCalibrationStatus (showing the revision: original claims dropped, denial substituted), the Narrative_InstrumentCalibrationVerification (holding all three expressions including the denial), and every expression in the calibration lifecycle — the original claims (Expr_1ForgetLifecycleTarget_1–4), the revocation directives (Expr_3ForgetLifecycleRetractTarget_1–2), and the denial (Expr_3ForgetLifecycleRetractTarget_3) — so the passes can see the full forget/retract lifecycle this document bears on. I also expanded Actor_QuillAshgrove as the document's participant. I deliberately did NOT expand the Quixotic Zeppelin fleet items (Expr_4ForgetLifecycleNonexistent_1–2) or the onboarding checklist position/narrative, as they concern unrelated transport and HR domains with no overlap to this calibration document.
